dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Hand colored. Relief shown by hachures. Depths shown in fathoms. Cadastral map. Shows administrative boundaries. Prime meridian: London and Ferro. Includes statistical information, profile of Nevis, and inset "Nevis, by Thomas Jefferys." Scale ca. 1:53,000.
